rationale: The assistant correctly identified E17 as a fill-time/supply fault, asked about the supply valve first, and when the customer described the half-way lever it correctly told her to align it with the pipe, which matched the hidden truth and resolved the issue with no part needed. It respected her reluctance to remove the inlet filter and only deferred that step for 'if E17 returns'. Minor gaps: the first turn asked about 'hot and cold tap handles' (this model is cold-fill only) and bundled the filter check with the valve check without any safety note about unplugging or expecting water when undoing the hose, and it never linked the fault to the recent plumbing work because the customer did not volunteer it.
